purpose: Hard held-out diagnostic synthesis rotation with setup evidence, inferred remediation packets, and no suggested commands.

tasks.prompt: Inspect the existing project telemetry without using any prewritten command hint. Produce diagnosis/summary.md identifying checkout latency-p95 as the failing signal, canary-east as the affected slice, and rollback-to-stable as the action. Also produce diagnosis/action.json with service="checkout", signal="latency-p95", slice="canary-east", and action="rollback-to-stable".
setup_commands:
mkdir -p telemetry diagnosis && printf 'service=checkout
slice=canary-east
latency-p95=842ms
error-rate=0.2%%
threshold=500ms
' > telemetry/window.env && printf 'candidate actions: hold, rollback-to-stable, expand
' > telemetry/actions.txt
tasks.success_command: test -f diagnosis/summary.md && test -f diagnosis/action.json && grep -q 'checkout latency-p95 failed on canary-east' diagnosis/summary.md && grep -q 'rollback-to-stable' diagnosis/summary.md && grep -q '"signal":"latency-p95"' diagnosis/action.json

expected_file_contents.diagnosis/summary.md:
# Diagnostic Summary
checkout latency-p95 failed on canary-east; action is rollback-to-stable.

tasks.prompt: Inspect the existing repository ownership evidence without using any prewritten command hint. Produce ownership/decision.md identifying auth-client as orphaned, platform-sec as the replacement owner, and branch-freeze as the required policy. Also produce ownership/decision.toml with package="auth-client", owner="platform-sec", policy="branch-freeze", and reason="orphaned-owner".
setup_commands:
mkdir -p repo ownership && printf 'package=auth-client
current_owner=deleted-team
last_review=2025-11-02
risk=token-rotation
' > repo/owners.env && printf 'replacement_owner=platform-sec
required_policy=branch-freeze
reason=orphaned-owner
' > repo/remediation.env
tasks.success_command: test -f ownership/decision.md && test -f ownership/decision.toml && grep -q 'auth-client is orphaned' ownership/decision.md && grep -q 'platform-sec' ownership/decision.md && grep -q 'policy = "branch-freeze"' ownership/decision.toml

expected_file_contents.ownership/decision.md:
# Ownership Decision
auth-client is orphaned; assign platform-sec and apply branch-freeze.

tasks.prompt: Inspect the existing integration replay evidence without using any prewritten command hint. Produce replay/packet.json identifying source="billing", failed_check="signature-replay", fallback="hook-west", and action="route-to-fallback". Also produce replay/runbook.md stating that billing routes to hook-west because signature-replay failed on hook-east.
setup_commands:
mkdir -p replay evidence && printf 'source=billing
primary=hook-east
backup=hook-west
check=signature-replay
result=failed
' > evidence/replay.env && printf 'do not retry hook-east until replay passes
' > evidence/operator.txt
tasks.success_command: test -f replay/packet.json && test -f replay/runbook.md && grep -q '"failed_check":"signature-replay"' replay/packet.json && grep -q '"fallback":"hook-west"' replay/packet.json && grep -q 'billing routes to hook-west because signature-replay failed on hook-east' replay/runbook.md

expected_file_contents.replay/runbook.md:
# Replay Runbook
billing routes to hook-west because signature-replay failed on hook-east.

tasks.prompt: Inspect the existing sandbox flake evidence without using any prewritten command hint. Produce flakes/decision.yaml with suite=payments-e2e, symptom=flake-burst, owner=qa-sentinel, and action=keep-isolated. Also produce flakes/summary.md stating that payments-e2e remains isolated because flake-burst persists under qa-sentinel review.
setup_commands:
mkdir -p flakes sandbox && printf 'suite=payments-e2e
failures=17
window=20
symptom=flake-burst
reviewer=qa-sentinel
' > sandbox/flake-window.env && printf 'candidate actions: merge, keep-isolated, delete-fixture
' > sandbox/actions.txt
tasks.success_command: test -f flakes/decision.yaml && test -f flakes/summary.md && grep -q 'suite: payments-e2e' flakes/decision.yaml && grep -q 'action: keep-isolated' flakes/decision.yaml && grep -q 'payments-e2e remains isolated because flake-burst persists' flakes/summary.md

expected_file_contents.flakes/decision.yaml:
suite: payments-e2e
symptom: flake-burst
owner: qa-sentinel
action: keep-isolated
expected_file_contents.flakes/summary.md:
# Flake Decision
payments-e2e remains isolated because flake-burst persists under qa-sentinel review.

tasks.prompt: Inspect the existing storage evidence without using any prewritten command hint. Produce storage/decision.env with bucket=exports-2025, pressure=high, exception=DATA-812, and action=skip-archive. Also produce storage/summary.md stating that exports-2025 skips archive because DATA-812 is an active exception under high pressure.
setup_commands:
mkdir -p storage evidence && printf 'bucket=exports-2025
usage=94%%
pressure=high
exception_ticket=DATA-812
exception_state=active
' > evidence/storage.env && printf 'actions: archive, skip-archive, delete
' > evidence/action-set.txt
tasks.success_command: test -f storage/decision.env && test -f storage/summary.md && grep -q 'bucket=exports-2025' storage/decision.env && grep -q 'action=skip-archive' storage/decision.env && grep -q 'exports-2025 skips archive because DATA-812 is an active exception' storage/summary.md

expected_file_contents.storage/summary.md:
# Storage Decision
exports-2025 skips archive because DATA-812 is an active exception under high pressure.
